description: The Tutorial Language setting (Settings > Gameplay). Players reported Da Boss's Ork dialect makes the tutorial harder to parse, so every lesson string now ships in two voices: plain-English base keys (the default for real players) and *_orky twins. The automated harness pins runs to the orky baseline so the existing tut_* pins hold, which is exactly why this scenario must OPT OUT explicitly: it calls SettingsService.set_tutorial_language("standard") (an explicit choice clears the pin), then proves the standard voice end to end on the real player path - picker header 'Basic Training', the T1 welcome card barking 'WELCOME, COMMANDER!' under an 'INSTRUCTOR' chip with a 'Scouting the Field' progress line, and the exit confirm asking in plain English with 'Leave Lesson' / 'Keep Playing' buttons. It then flips to orky MID-LESSON and asserts the very same card re-renders as 'OI, LISTEN UP!' under 'DA BOSS' - the language change applies live, no restart. ScenarioRunner's hermetic settings handling byte-restores settings.cfg afterwards, so the set_tutorial_language persistence never leaks off this run.

steps.comment: the explicit choice steps out from under the harness orky pin
a fresh profile pops the first-launch nudge over the menu (z95, input-blocking) - dismiss it or it swallows the picker clicks below
picker header speaks plain English (orky says Basic Trainin')
the lesson row title resolves the standard voice from the lessons cache

steps.script:
var b = tree.root.get_node("TutorialOverlay/InstructorCard/Margin/VBox/BodyText")
return ("Basic Training" in b.text) and not ("Trainin'" in b.text) and not (" da " in b.text)
steps.comment: the card body is the plain-English variant with no dialect leftovers

steps.script:
var p = tree.root.get_node("TutorialOverlay/InstructorCard/Margin/VBox/Footer/ProgressLabel")
return "Scouting the Field" in p.text

var d = tree.root.get_node("TutorialExitConfirm")
return d.ok_button_text + " / " + d.cancel_button_text
steps.comment: the exit confirm asks in the selected voice too (orky: Leg it! / Keep Playin')
flip voices MID-LESSON - tutorial_language_changed re-renders the live card

steps.script:
var p = tree.root.get_node("TutorialOverlay/InstructorCard/Margin/VBox/Footer/ProgressLabel")
return "Scoutin' da Field" in p.text
steps.comment: same lesson, same step, Da Boss back on the card without a restart
